name: PANJIT International Inc.
summary: PANJIT International Inc. manufactures, processes, assembles, imports, and exports semiconductors in Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It manufactures and sells wafers, power components, and control modules. The company also engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and technology consultation of power management ICs, field effect transistors, and fast recovery diodes; and sale of solar electricity. In addition, it offers MOSFET and Schottky products, SiC devices, signal chain and motor control ICs, temperature sensors, IGBTs, diode rectifiers, protection devices, bipolar junction transistors, bridges, and package technology.
